editorial:
If you love a good action thriller with a tough hero, this one delivers plenty of punches. Tom Cruise returns as Jack Reacher, a drifter who used to run a military police unit. When his friend and replacement, Major Susan Turner, gets framed for espionage, Reacher jumps back into action to clear her name. The story moves fast, with plenty of fights, chases, and close calls. Reacher is the kind of guy who never backs down, and watching him team up with Turner makes for a fun buddy dynamic. The plot is simple but keeps you guessing about who is really behind the killings of Reacher's old soldiers.

The action scenes are the real highlight. Cruise does his own stunts, and you can feel the impact in every fight. Cobie Smulders holds her own as Turner, bringing toughness and heart. The pacing rarely slows down, though some twists feel predictable. If you want a smart, layered thriller, this might not be your pick. But if you want a fun, popcorn-style action movie with a likable hero, you will have a great time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final act, Reacher and Turner uncover that a corrupt military contractor is behind the framing and the murders. They confront the bad guys in a tense showdown, clearing Turner's name. Reacher also learns that a teenage girl named Samantha might be his daughter, and he chooses to protect her. In the end, Reacher walks away alone again, leaving Turner to her command, while Samantha stays safe. The twist is that Reacher finally shows a softer side, hinting he might settle down someday.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action thrillers with a tough, no-nonsense hero.
